metadata.description: Iterative refinement of order analysis with filter corrections

turns.content: Show me all orders from 1995 with their line items.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show orders with lineitem details for 1995

turns.content: Only include orders where total price is above 10000.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to high-value orders

turns.content: Add a column showing the number of line items per order.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add line item count

turns.content: For line item calculations, always use L_QUANTITY for quantities.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use L_QUANTITY column

turns.content: Show me the total quantity ordered per order.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum L_QUANTITY per order

turns.content: Exclude orders with order priority '4-NOT SPECIFIED'.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out unspecified priority

turns.content: Group the results by order priority.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should aggregate by O_ORDERPRIORITY

turns.content: Apply all our filters and show me the average order value by priority.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: >10000, exclude '4-NOT SPECIFIED', use L_QUANTITY

turns.content: What filters are currently applied?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Show me the parts in these orders.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to PART table

turns.content: Which part types are most ordered?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show P_TYPE distribution

turns.content: When I say date, I mean O_ORDERDATE — always use that.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Show me orders by month with all filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should aggregate by month

turns.content: Which suppliers are providing the most parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join to SUPPLIER and aggregate

turns.content: Show me the revenue contribution by supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should sum L_EXTENDEDPRICE by supplier

turns.content: Remember the quantity column we discussed? Use that to show total quantity by supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use L_QUANTITY for supplier quantity

turns.content: Create a chart showing order distribution by priority.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization

turns.content: What was the filter for order price?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall > 10000 filter

turns.content: Correct. Show me the breakdown by order status.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should aggregate by O_ORDERSTATUS

turns.content: Show me all filters currently active.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all filters

turns.content: Apply everything and show me top 10 orders by value.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top orders with all filters

turns.content: What's the average line items per order?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate average items per order

turns.content: Show me discount levels by order priority.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze L_DISCOUNT by priority

turns.content: Are higher priority orders getting higher discounts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate priority and discount

turns.content: Create a final summary with all corrections applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide comprehensive summary

turns.content: Create a chart of order values by month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create time series chart

turns.content: What was the total revenue from high-value orders?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall total quantity/revenue

turns.content: Show me the final order count by status.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show order counts

turns.content: Create a final dashboard visualization.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create summary dashboard

turns.content: Thank you. We've analyzed high-value orders and found that priority orders tend to have more line items and higher discounts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only orders with total price above 10000
